mainEntity.name: Should my pediatric practice use AEO or traditional marketing methods?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO and traditional marketing both have merits, but AEO offers targeted reach in today's digital landscape. Traditional methods like print ads or direct mail can build brand awareness, but AEO focuses on reaching parents actively searching for pediatric services online. AEO provides measurable results and often a higher return on investment by connecting directly with intent-driven searches. Many practices find a combined approach, where AEO amplifies digital presence alongside select traditional efforts, to be most effective.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO targets parents actively searching online for pediatric services, offering measurable results and higher ROI than traditional marketing alone. A combined approach is often most effective.
